test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

He didn’t / called me / in the / last week
solution:
The erroneous part is: **called me**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The base form of verb **(V1) **is always used after 'do' and 'did'.

 
 
• For example:
 
 
• I did **go** there.
 
• I did not** know** about this secret place.
 
 
 
 
 
• Similarly, in this context, 'didn't' must be followed by the base form of verb.
 
• Hence, 'called' (V2) must be replaced by 'call' (V1).

Therefore, the correct answer is: *He didn’t **call **me in the last week.*
